description.zh: 跨源地址池回源配置。
description.en: The cross-origin address pool back-to-origin configuration.

description.zh: 默认地址池列表。
description.en: The list of default address pool IDs.

description.zh: 负载均衡器的详细描述信息，便于管理和识别。
description.en: The description of the load balancer for management and identification purposes.

description.zh:
负载均衡器是否启用。

- true：启用。
- false：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether the load balancer is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

description.zh: 兜底地址池ID，当所有其他池不可用时，流量将被导向此处。
description.en: The fallback address pool ID. Traffic is directed to this pool when all other pools are unavailable.

description.zh: 监视器配置，用于健康检查。
description.en: The monitor configuration for health checks.

description.zh: 负载均衡器名称，需要满足域名格式校验，并且是站点下的子域名。
description.en: The name of the load balancer. The name must be in a valid domain name format and must be a subdomain of the site.

description.zh: 加权轮询配置，用于控制不同地址池的流量分配权重。
description.en: The weighted round-robin configuration that controls the traffic distribution weight across different address pools.

description.zh: 一级region对应的地址池。
description.en: The address pools mapped to primary regions.

description.zh: 规则信息。
description.en: The rule information.

description.zh: 匹配规则后执行响应指定内容。
description.en: The fixed response content returned after a rule is matched.

description.zh: 匹配规则后修改对应请求改写的负载均衡配置，配置的字段，会覆盖负载均衡器配置里相应的字段。
description.en: The load balancing configuration that overwrites the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration when a rule is matched. The specified fields overwrite the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content that uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，可以不填，不填时以列表顺序执行，如果填的话，是大于0的整数。数值越大越优先执行。
description.en: The rule execution order. This parameter is optional. If not specified, rules are executed in list order. If specified, the value must be a positive integer. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh:
是否终止执行后续规则。

- true：是。
- false：否，默认值。
description.en:
Specifies whether to stop executing subsequent rules. Valid values:

- true: Stop executing subsequent rules.
- false: Continue executing subsequent rules. This is the default value.

description.zh:
会话保持。取值范围：
- off：不开启。
- ip：按ip方式会话保持。
- cookie: 按cookie方式会话保持。
- http_header：按http header方式会话保持。
description.en:
The session persistence mode. Valid values:
- off: disabled.
- ip: IP-based session persistence.
- cookie: cookie-based session persistence.
- http_header: HTTP header-based session persistence.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh:
负载均衡策略。

- geo: 地址策略。
- random: 加权轮询。
- order: 主备方式。
description.en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- geo: geo-based routing.
- random: weighted round-robin.
- order: primary/secondary mode.

description.zh: 二级region对应的地址池，多个二级region共用一批地址池时，可以多个二级region，使用逗号拼接作为key。
description.en: The address pools mapped to secondary regions. If multiple secondary regions share the same set of address pools, you can concatenate the secondary region names with commas as the key.

description.zh: TTL值，DNS记录的生存时间，默认为30秒。取值范围：10-600。
description.en: The TTL value, which specifies the time-to-live of the DNS record. Default value: 30 seconds. Valid values: 10 to 600.

descriptions.zh:
通过此API，用户可以根据业务需求配置负载均衡服务，包括但不限于自适应路由、加权轮询、规则匹配、健康检查等设置，以实现流量的有效管理和优化。

只有企业版套餐支持负载均衡器服务，如需使用请联系阿里云销售申请企业版套餐。
descriptions.en:
Creates a load balancing service based on your business requirements. You can configure settings such as adaptive routing, weighted polling, rule matching, and health checks to effectively manage and optimize traffic.

Only Enterprise plans support the load balancing service. To use this feature, contact Alibaba Cloud sales to apply for an Enterprise plan.
